summary: Reviewed the frozen proposal across all eight sync, conflict, recovery and AI surfaces, their state/affordance mappings, mobile and accessibility plans, protocol/runtime contracts, implementation slices and relevant accepted/native baselines. The dependent-action preservation/reapproval/discard and AI cancellation/interruption additions address their earlier missing states. One consequential gap remains: the new native suggestion sheets do not specify the existing navigator clarifying-question response and answer workflow. Owner design acceptance, native rendering/accessibility, sizing and implementation measurements remain disclosed future gates; this review performed no runtime verification.

findings.description: When a task has insufficient information for a grounded suggestion, the existing navigator can successfully return proposals:null and a clarifying_question. The proposed new M-04/D-04 sheets enumerate only proposal editing or no suitable suggestion, with no question/answer affordance or mapped answer-save/rerun states. These clients were explicitly deferred in 020, so there is no existing native question UI to inherit. Treating this valid response as empty/error would prevent the accepted answer-to-notes-and-suggest-again path, while rendering the answer as a proposal would apply the wrong task change. This violates the stated preservation of the existing Weekly Review capability and 020-FR-021 rather than requesting another AI feature.
evidence: specs/026-rust-core-sync/design.md:94 and :100: M-04/D-04 response states specify no proposal or an editable suggestion; the complete .01-.15 inventory has no clarifying-question/answer state.

specs/026-rust-core-sync/design.md:109; specs/026-rust-core-sync/plan.md:137; specs/026-rust-core-sync/tasks.md:149-153 (T049/T059/T060): new native sheets consume the existing Weekly Review navigator capability; their native client UI did not previously exist.
specs/020-weekly-review/spec.md:312 (FR-021): a task clarification answer is appended to notes through a normal edit and the navigator runs again on the updated input.

specs/020-weekly-review/contracts/http.md:741-745: exactly one of proposals or clarifying_question is non-null; backend/app/modules/tasks/navigator.py:491-495 and :1059-1064 implement this valid response.
ios/BrainBuddyKit/Sources/BrainBuddyAPI/ReviewAPI.swift:846-871: the current Swift DTO explicitly decodes and validates the mutually exclusive clarifyingQuestion branch.
specs/020-weekly-review/design.md:232 and :597-601: accepted question/answer affordance, focus, answer-save failure and answer-saved/suggestion-failed states provide the reusable baseline.
findings.recommendation: Add stable M-04/D-04 question and answer states, or explicitly map/adopt the existing 020 M-05/M-07 question states for these new sheets. Specify the answer field and Add to notes and suggest again/manual continuation actions, preserve the answer draft, distinguish notes-save failure from a subsequent suggestion failure, adopt the newly saved task revision and retry inference without appending the answer twice. Bind this existing response branch to PR-49/59/60 and their planned acceptance evidence.
